answer: One concrete lever is co-activation correlation. Masks driven by a single shared inference pipeline answer in synchronized bursts and share funding ancestry, flowing like one river of identical behavior. The protocol keeps an atlas of each identity's response timing and funding-path overlap; clusters that move as one mind have rewards collapsed into a single share. Lookalikes that bleed the same behavioral pigment buy nothing, since each gain is split, not multiplied. To look uncorrelated the attacker must pay full independent compute per mask, so the swarm costs more than one honest agent.
